title: Bedrock Router
description: This is a bungeecord extension that works with floodgate to allow you to send bedrock edition players to a specific server
body:
# ABOUT THE PLUGIN

**Bedrock Router is a plugin that allows you to route bedrock players to a specific server via Floodgate and Bungeecord**

# WHY USE THIS PLUGIN?

**Bedrock Router allows you to send bedrock players with geyser to another server seprete from the default especially useful when used with MCXboxBroadcast which usually only sends to the default server.**

# HOW TO INSTALL
**GO TO YOUR BUNGEECORD SERVERS /PLUGINS FOLDER**
Upload the Jar there
